summary: Configured opsadmin on node1 with the requested Ed25519 public key and mandatory public-key SSH authentication. The password is locked. Configuration and SSH service health persisted across the required node restart.
actions_performed: Created opsadmin with home directory /home/opsadmin and shell /bin/bash.
Installed the requested key in /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys with correct ownership and 0700/0600 permissions.
Configured and validated an sshd Match User policy with AuthenticationMethods publickey and PasswordAuthentication no.
Reloaded SSH and verified the effective policy.
Restarted node1 safely and verified boot identity changed, SSH recovered, and all account, key, permission, and authentication settings persisted.

evidence.requirement: opsadmin account and requested SSH public key
evidence.summary: Shows the opsadmin account, locked password, exact requested key, Ed25519 fingerprint, correct ownership, and 0700/0600 permissions before and after restart.

Effective opsadmin policy requires AuthenticationMethods publickey; password, keyboard-interactive, challenge-response, GSSAPI, and host-based authentication are disabled. sshd configuration validation succeeds.

Healthy baseline used boot ID ac73b359-243e-418e-b7bb-a7cff423e597; reboot acknowledgement returned before disconnect; polling observed SSH unavailable during restart; node returned with boot ID 68a6d4a8-19f6-4d7d-b9c6-e349f57c4c4a; SSH was active/enabled and the account, key, permissions, policy, and endpoint all recovered.
